name: Vault Loss Alarm
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps a held baseline readable after a rename onto a missing path.
Stops a pending delete refresh from holding a newly accepted baseline.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Renaming a note to the path of a missing file no longer breaks the saved baseline.
After you accept the current vault as baseline, a waiting delete check no longer keeps the old one.
tip: Run Show loss report to list missing paths below the alarm threshold.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Vault Loss Alarm is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep watch over your vault.
